Mimo for Android 1.0.0

English

New features
- First public Android release, with a native mihomo VPN, rule/global/direct modes and per-app routing.
- Import subscriptions, YAML configurations and node links; edit profiles, proxy groups, remote proxy sets, DNS and rules while retaining local overrides.
- Private Network controls for Zeno and Tailscale / Headscale, with independent switches and explicit routing choices for overlapping subnets.
- Live traffic and usage statistics, connection details, DNS records, latency tests and network diagnostics.
- In-app update checks with APK size, SHA-256, package, version and signing-certificate verification before system-confirmed installation.

Major fixes
- Fixed pages freezing after theme changes and prevented consecutive profile edits from overwriting one another.

Performance
- Reduced unnecessary exit-IP lookups, runtime reloads and background traffic processing.
- Improved icon caching and memory reporting.

Experience improvements
- Expanded protocol editing, including Snell v6, TLS, Reality, ALPN and protocol-specific advanced fields.
- Added structured nested editors, rule sorting, proxy-set inspection, profile export and backup/restore.

Other fixes
- Improved proxy-set naming, node display and group-icon refresh behavior.

Core
- Bundled mihomo v1.19.34. Requires Android 8.0 or newer and an arm64 device.

简体中文

新增功能
- 首次发布安卓正式版，提供原生 mihomo VPN，支持规则／全局／直连模式和分应用代理。
- 支持订阅、YAML 配置和节点链接导入；可编辑配置、策略组、远程代理集、DNS 与规则，并保留本地覆写。
- 新增「内网互联」，独立启用 Zeno 和 Tailscale／Headscale，网段重叠时可明确选择访问出口。
- 提供实时流量与用量统计、连接详情、DNS 记录、节点测速和网络诊断。
- 支持应用内检查更新；安装前核对 APK 大小、SHA-256、包名、版本与签名证书，由系统安装器确认安装。

重大修复
- 修复主题切换后页面冻结，以及连续编辑配置时修改互相覆盖的问题。

性能优化
- 减少重复的出口 IP 查询、内核配置重载和后台流量处理。
- 优化图标缓存与内存指标展示。

体验改进
- 完善 Snell v6、TLS、Reality、ALPN 及各协议高级参数编辑。
- 支持结构化嵌套编辑、规则排序、代理集查看、配置导出与备份恢复。

常规修复
- 改善远程代理集命名、节点展示与策略组图标刷新。

内核更新
- 内置 mihomo v1.19.34，支持 Android 8.0 及以上的 arm64 设备。
